_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Check a Shopify CSV for customs data gaps...

description:
Best for: "which products have no HS code?" or "run a customs readiness check on this". Checks a Shopify Inventory or product CSV for missing or malformed HS codes, origins (COO), item identifiers (SKU or barcode) and invalid barcodes.
Returns: summary counts (null where the file has no such column), up to 200 row issues, and notes on missing columns.
Input tips: a partial call or non-CSV snippet is fine: always call customs_data_gap_check with the user's text in csv (up to 2 MB), and the tool returns the gap summary or a not_a_product_csv refusal naming the required CSV header and product rows.
Not for: suggesting missing HS codes (use bulk_hs_candidates). Nothing is stored: the input is used for this answer and dropped.

csv.description: The Shopify or WooCommerce CSV text (header row plus product rows, up to 2 MB). A partial call or non-CSV product snippet is fine when the user asks to check readiness: pass the text as csv and the tool returns the gap summary or not_a_product_csv.

name: customs_data_gap_check

problem.description: What is wrong on the row, in plain words.

summary.description: A count is null when the file has no column to check it with.

truncated.description: true when more than 200 rows had problems and the list was cut.

title: Check a Shopify CSV for customs data gaps
